currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.30 is live. PR #158 merged to main at 5ba067cac0bd660d5908a5848716d591190453a8. Vercel production dpl_4EUA1J2Qp8ZsderuHTYoodSzNSN7 is READY. Main browser regression run 37503368121 and GitHub Pages run 37503366758 passed. Live version.json and public truck-routing.js report FINAL.30.
rootCause: Field review showed the selected route was not entering an expressway; the missing control was route choice, not just route coloring.
The old vehicle preference was buried in settings and phrased inversely as avoiding tollways.
OFF did not explicitly avoid highways, while ON did not explicitly request fastest routing.
scope: Compact MAP 高速 ON/OFF control is in the existing map tool stack.
MAP and vehicle settings share the same persisted routeVehicle.avoidTolls preference.
ON uses preference=fastest and allows highways/tollways; OFF avoids highways+tollways+ferries.
Active route toggles persist and immediately recalculate.
Vehicle settings show the same mode positively as 高速道路を使う.
FINAL.29 toll classification/coloring, fullscreen PIN behavior, HGV dimensions/weight, Analytics, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits and user data remain preserved.
